Marco Diaz: Hi @finance — quick one. Corporate card got declined at check-in for my conference hotel in NYC (May 28). I paid $318 on my personal card. How do I file for reimbursement?
Aisha (Finance): Sorry about that, Marco. Submit an expense in Concur as "Hotel - reimbursement" and attach: hotel folio showing the charge, the hotel receipt, your personal card statement showing the payment (last4), and a short note: reason corp card declined if known.
Marco Diaz: Hotel only gave a folio, no itemized receipt (they said folios are standard). Is that okay?
Aisha (Finance): Folio is acceptable if it shows nightly rate and total. If the folio lacks a card signature line, add a short manager approval in the notes.
June Park: Also confirm whether any incident was reported to card ops. Finance needs that if the bank flags a dispute.
Marco Diaz: I pinged card-ops but no response yet. I'll forward any ticket.
Aisha (Finance): FYI missing receipt flow: 1) attach folio or card stmt showing charge 2) manager approval in Concur 3) add note explaining the gap. We'll process within 3 business days after approval.
Marco Diaz: Submitted expense with attachments (folio.pdf, personal-visa-7890.png) and manager sign-off.
finance-bot: Expense ticket EXP-2026-8275 created, assigned to Aisha. ETA 3 business days.
Aisha (Finance): Thanks — I'll queue the reimbursement. One more: please mark the expense as "out-of-pocket" so payroll routes correctly; otherwise it may default to card settlement.
Marco Diaz: Marked as out-of-pocket. Any guidance to avoid declines next time?
Aisha (Finance): Two tips: 1) Add a travel hold before big hotel stays via card-ops (they can notify issuer). 2) For reservations with incidental pre-authorizations, ask the hotel to split incidental hold from room charge when possible.
Marco Diaz: Great, thanks. Closing thread if all good.
Aisha (Finance): All good — reimbursement will hit next payroll run unless you request ACH.
